hooks.name: typecheck-before-task
hooks.description: Refuse to start a spec task when the workspace does not typecheck.

hooks.name: engine-tests-on-save
hooks.description: Run engine tests whenever Kiro changes an engine source file.

hooks.name: property-tests-after-task
hooks.description: After a spec task, run the property tests for that spec and report any counterexample against the requirement it validates.

action.prompt: Run the property-based tests for the spec task that just completed. If any property fails, report the shrunken counterexample and the requirement ID it validates. Do not change code. Report only.
